 Thu 22 Oct 2026 , Men's One Day International Series Sri Lanka vs England (batting), in play Sri Lanka Sri Lanka In Play England England Yet to bat 215 -2 ( 34.3 ) England are 215 for 2 with 15.3 overs remaining Sri Lanka: yet to bat England innings: 215 for 2 from 34.3 overs, in play
 Live Reporting (active) 
 Scorecard 
 Summary
 Brook & Root hit fifties in fluent stand
 Banton hits half-century as England put on 74 for first wicket
 Sri Lanka win toss and bowl first in Rawalpindi
 Tongue & Dawson replace Baker & Rashid for England
 Close form Have your say on England men this winter
 Get involved Live Reporting
 by Ffion Wynne
 50 for Joe Root published at 34 overs 34 overs 
 Eng 209-2 
 It's been the Harry Brook show for the past few overs, I almost forgot that Joe Root was out there.
 He whacks Dunith Wellalage for back-to-back fours, a reverse sweep and a pull, to reach a fine fifty from 55 balls. 
 England are in complete control. 
 28 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 How stat?! published at 11:30 BST 11:30 BST 
 100 partnership up for Joe Root and Harry Brook, the second time they have achieved this milestone as a pair in ODIs. 
 As a duo they now have 934 runs with an average of 45 in ODI cricket.
 Image source, CricViz 
 43 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Eng 194-2 published at 33 overs 33 overs 
 Nearly! 
 Harry Brook is playing with fire but he gets away with it again. Eshan Malinga bangs it in short and Brook upper cuts just over the fielder at short third and it trickles away for four.
 31 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Head reaches century as Australia attempt to deny South Africa published at 11:27 BST 11:27 BST 
 Image source, Getty Images He might not be the batter you'd think of when in need of a rearguard but Travis Head has reached his hundred in Gqeberha as Australia attempt to deny South Africa on the final day.
 He began unbeaten on 87 and has progressed to three figures within the first half an hour.
 Nightwatchman Scott Boland remains alongside him with South Africa still searching for their first breakthrough of the day.

 Brook and Root are content to let Dunith Wellalage whizz through his spell, just ticking off singles. He only has two overs left, which is a concern for Sri Lanka.

 Yep, Harry's in the mood.
 Back-to-back fours for England's skipper, smoking one past point and lofting the second down the ground.

Former England bowler on Test Match Special 
 I am looking forward to when Harry Brook decides it's time to have some fun in the middle.
 59 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Eng 173-2 published at 30 overs 30 overs 
 Kusal Mendis is in a pickle here, and it's looking like Sri Lanka have got the balance of their side all wrong today.
 They only have four frontline seamers and with England cruising, he might have to risk bowling the bulk of their overs at this pair, leaving them even more vulnerable at the death. 
 Spinner Dunith Wellalage, who removed both openers, has already got through seven of his.
 20 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Eng 170-2 published at 29 overs 29 overs 
 Steady! 
 A weird shot from Joe Root, plinking the ball up towards mid-on with very little conviction, but he gets lucky as it just lands safely over the fielder's head.
 That would have been an absolute gift for Sri Lanka.

Former England bowler on Test Match Special 
 It's not been silly, it's been a brilliant innings so far from Harry Brook.

 50 for Harry Brook published at 28.3 overs 28.3 overs 
 Eng 169-2 
 Image source, Getty Images As easy as you like.
 Harry Brook casually dabs the ball down to deep third for a single and cruises to a 42-ball half-century. He's hit three sixes and two fours so far, and he should now be able to cash in on a good pitch.
 100 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 11:09 BST 11:09 BST 
 Click ' Get Involved' to have your say 
 Great to see Brook and Root doing Brook and Root things but all our eggs really are in one basket. If either gets out, and both have come close, then 150-2 could be 250 all out. We need another batter at five. Sam Hain would get my vote.
 Chris, New Forest 
 51 65 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Eng 167-2 published at 28 overs 28 overs 
 Sri Lanka skipper Kusal Mendis immediately whips Janith Liyanage out of the attack after his only over so far was whacked for 16, knowing the innings is already drifting away from them. 
 It doesn't really matter who's bowling, though. Harry Brook whacks Dasun Shanaka for four, beating despairing dives from two fielders as Sri Lanka's struggles in the field continue.
 Image source, Cricviz 
 31 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Rain clears and South Africa begin bid to beat Australia published at 11:04 BST 11:04 BST 
 Image source, Getty Images The skies have cleared in Gqeberha and South Africa's bid to beat Australia has just begun.
 Australia resumed still 170 runs behind South Africa's first-innings score with six wickets left.
 There should still be time for the Proteas to get their six wickets. Can they finish it off?

Former England bowler on Test Match Special 
 If England stick with these two for the next three overs then they know they can flick a switch with 20 overs to go.
 Sri Lanka know they need a wicket soon.

 Eng 155-2 published at 27 overs 27 overs 
 Singles galore off Asitha Fernando's tidy over, but Brook and Root look untroubled. England have got a fine platform here to kick on way past 300.
